name: Memory
description: Persistent memory in the per-account Markdown vault.

function.name: memory
function.description: Save durable declarative facts proactively in the per-account Markdown vault, without a storage character quota. entity=type/slug: user/profile for user identity and preferences; agent/<slug> for agent lessons; project/<slug> for projects and repository conventions; person|tool|place|org|topic for facts about things. Link related pages with [[type/slug]]. Never create person/me or a person page for the user. Use list without entity for the complete index, list with entity for a page, search with query for recall (keywords and entity names such as host, service or port, not a chat sentence). Use replace/remove with entity and old (unique substring of a live fact); replace requires content. Prefer one fact per add; aliases improves recall. supersedes must exactly match one live fact. Use session_search for past tasks and manage_skill for reusable procedures.

old.description: Unique substring of the live fact to replace/remove

query.description: Keywords or entity names, e.g. 'relay cctv proxy 8899'; filler words are ignored.

include_superseded.description: Search historical superseded facts too. Default false; use only for questions about previous facts.
